title: Ptyalism

content_blocks.text: Excessive production and secretion of saliva
Pseudoptyalism is the excessive release of saliva that has accumulated in the oral cavity due to inability to swallow.

Symptomatic treatment to reduce the flow of saliva—generally unnecessary, may be of little value to the patient, and may mask other signs of the underlying cause and thus delay diagnosis; only recommended when hypersalivation is prolonged and severe and, if possible, after the underlying condition has been diagnosed.
